clauses.title: Scope – Requirements of manufacture, dimensions
clauses.text: 1.    Scope - Requirements of manufacture, dimensions and marking for fabricated PVC 45 o bends for potable water supplies.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 2.   Requirements — The general requirements for materials, sizes, methods of test, sampling and critieria for  conformity shall conform to  IS 10124 (Part 1) : 1988.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions — See  Table 1. SUMMARY OF IS 10124 (PART 10) : 1988 FABRICATED PVC FITTING FOR POTABLE WATER SUPPLIES. PART  10 SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS FOR 45O BENDS. (First Revision)
